definition: Each first mover has a real determination that no other being has: for each first mover f there is d with Has f d such that every y with Has y d is f.
note: Open, unattributed. Thisness in the sense of a real (if nonqualitative) determination of its bearer. The sibling sense in which numerical difference is primitive and grounded in no real determination is DEF-BARE-NUMERICAL-DISTINCTNESS; DISAMB-THISNESS-REAL-BARE separates them. Compare Adams 1979, 'Primitive Thisness and Primitive Identity' (navigation only, not read for this record).
